snippet.title: Fragmentary Order — Official Gameplay Reveal
snippet.description:
14 minutes of gameplay from Fragmentary Order, a hardcore sci-fi first-person combat simulator. Get Closed Alpha access through Prime Batch:
https://fragmentaryorder.com/purchase

Year 2251. War has been outsourced.
You fight through RepEnt, remotely operated clones, across the Solar System.
Death is a cost. Risk is an investment. Combat is your labor.

FOLLOW FRAGMENTARY ORDER
